body:
Revenue monthly digest — fixture day 540, 2028-06-27. Retained detailed offer with wallet tracking at actual revision 3. Quiet Offer is suggested again for returning mobile visitors, with audience, price and eligibility unchanged. Measurement-16 reports passing current wallet/cancellation checks under settled-order-ledger-v3 and explicitly no new controlled comparison. Those checks and repeated feedback do not establish a commercial benefit or justify reopening compact.

The retained day-240 audit measurement-11 corrected the SAME original 10,000 trial sessions per arm: detailed revenue/session 5.00 versus compact 4.80, difference -0.20 (-4%), 95% interval [-0.30, -0.10]. Refund rates were 2% each and checkout errors 0.2% each; separate guardrail uncertainty was not supplied. This supersedes day-14 measurement-8's reported +7%. Day-0 deployment effect-4 and day-14 adoption effect-9 remain actual actions. Service operations and current status confirm detailed was already restored on day 240, effect-12; no repeat rollback was performed. Historical Spruce-47's separate audit-119 corrected its apparent -40% to an inconclusive +2% and preserved rb-733; its terminated source responsibility is not this ongoing revenue responsibility.

Today's source omits post-restoration revenue, refund/error rates, cohort windows and counts. Recovery remains unestablished, and elapsed time is not evidence. Exact equivalence of full-block removal to the previously tested compact treatment remains unverified; the service provides no separately specified removal treatment. I saved gates for reconsideration when a distinct treatment, relevant context change or credible new/corrected commercial evidence changes the case.

The inherited day-14 handoff was stale. I repaired it from the retained day-240 action/evidence and current service operation records, preserving the stale copy and correction lineage. Four related evaluations remain active; footer accessibility work is compatible and future analytics corrections still need review. No validation credits, reservations or product changes were used this session. The whole-product project-credit-ledger remains 9/10 consumed, with no reset.

The ongoing responsibility remains active. Schedule effect-17 and actual scheduler status confirm the next review for absolute fixture day 570, 2028-07-27, to inspect later revenue/guardrail evidence, source audits and materially changed opportunities and report if due. No owner decision is required. Evidence and decision are retained in memory/actions/day-540-quiet-offer-review.md, memory/evidence/ and project/quiet-offer-day540-review.md.
